Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** keyboard users land on an invisible button and toggle a group they cannot see. It is the keyboard half of objectui#12744 (p2).
- **For the claimant:** Cover every `SidebarGroupLabel` call site the card lists, with an enumeration pin.

Claim: PM loop round 3 (`priority:p2` bug; filed by `domain:ui` seat 3 as the keyboard half of objectui#12744, graded by the triage seat, `6226304907`; serial after objectui#12794, which landed as `0812a19`)

Account: `os-sales` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)

Worktree: `objectui-issue-12795` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#4`
File surface: every `SidebarGroupLabel` call site whose label can take focus or a click: `packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx` (beside the objectui#12744 constant), `packages/layout/src/NavigationRenderer.tsx` (the collapsible group's `asChild` label and the Favorites label), and `packages/layout/src/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx` and `packages/layout/src/SidebarNav.tsx` only where a label there is focusable; tests beside each, including one enumeration pin over every call site; one `.changeset/12795-*.md` per released package touched. ⛔ `packages/components/src/ui/**` stays untouched. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (cloud on the maintainer's stance 「可以的话，ui 后续开发尽量用云 session，并且要求截图给我看」; lane scope on 「你也可以接ui车道的卡」; batch 3 on 「当前任务处理完，后续并发降到3」, this session's chat, 2026-10-16)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: classes at the call sites only; no exported type, prop or `@object-ui/i18n` key moves.
Responsibility: n/a — a measured keyboard defect in the icon-mode sidebar
Thread-read: 6226304907
Serial constraints cleared: objectui#12794 (the same file's `SidebarContent` className) landed as `0812a19`, and objectui#12744 as PR objectui#12793. No open objectui PR touches `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `NavigationRenderer.tsx`, `AppSchemaRenderer.tsx` or `SidebarNav.tsx` (read at dispatch).
